shots.description: A single circle opens into a huge, elastic ONE.
The circle becomes a plus; MORE expands across cobalt.
Three economic quantities enter as distinct typographic compositions.
A typographic line resolves into an illustrative profit curve.

shots.text: HOW FAST? RATE OF CHANGE. DERIVATIVE.
shots.description: A secant approaches a tangent. Finite and local rates are labelled separately.
Cash-flow rectangles refine into a shaded accumulation area.
Type assembles from two directions; a moving plus connects the ideas.

shots.text: Higher Mathematics: Calculus for Economics and Business. When does one more stop being worth it?
shots.description: An eight-second, calmer course-title and question hold.
